cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Organic Growth Analyst position. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in SEO, content, and web development, I am eager to contribute to your data-driven organic growth initiatives for B2B software clients.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that has improved organic visibility. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance using SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. This hands-on experience has taught me how to turn data into actionable insights and how to execute strategies that drive measurable results.

My personal project, mirook.com, has been a sandbox for advanced SEO and GEO techniques. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Running iterative technical audits, I raised the site's search-health score, demonstrating my ability to analyze, iterate, and improve.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of the clear career progression toward an Organic Growth Strategist. I am eager to deepen my expertise in analytics, content strategy, and conversion optimization, and to collaborate with a team of experienced strategists in a remote-first environment. I am comfortable working independently, managing multiple tasks, and communicating clearly with clients and colleagues.

I am available to overlap with Eastern Time hours and am ready to bring my analytical mindset, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn to your team. Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your clients' growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
